name: Galaxy Pegasus
description: The cosmic stallion reborn. Galaxy Pegasus soars into orbit to channel the power of star constellations, combining celestial energy into a swirling energy blast that crashes down from above.

ability.name: Stardust Driver / Galaxy Nova
ability.description: Pegasus flies into space to channel cosmic energy, combining with the constellation to attack the opponent in a swirling energy blast. Special Move deals bonus cosmic damage with a 40% crit chance for +40 bonus damage.

chain._note: Galaxy Nova: +30% damage amp on special activation

special_move.name: Starblast Attack
special_move.description: Pegasus flies high into the sky, channels the power of the galaxy, and dives down for a crushing star-powered strike!
flavour_texts: 🌟 **Starblast Attack** — Pegasus ascends into the cosmos!
💫 **Strike 2** — constellation energy ignites around the blades!
